title: Investor Relations Distribution | Earnings & Material News | PressCosmos
description: Regulation-aware distribution for earnings, funding and material news, with analyst-desk delivery, terminal feeds, quiet-period controls and full audit records.
body:
1. Home
  2. Services

Service

Material news needs a distribution record, not just a webpage.

When a release moves a share price, someone will eventually ask who received it and exactly when. The answer should be a timestamped log, not a recollection.

Talk to the IR teamEnterprise controls
Quick answer PressCosmos investor relations distribution delivers earnings releases, funding announcements and material news to financial terminals, analyst desks and major financial media. It supports quiet-period controls, multi-region regulatory variants, approval chains and an immutable distribution log for audit purposes.

Capabilities

Built for a disclosure regime

Earnings calendar

Schedule releases against your reporting calendar months ahead, with versioned drafts and staged approvals.

Terminal and analyst delivery

Delivery to financial data terminals and analyst desks across 41 markets, alongside standard media lanes.

Quiet-period controls

Lock distribution during defined windows and require named approval before anything can move.

Regulatory variants

Region-specific language and disclosure formatting, translated and reviewed by financial translators.

Immutable audit log

Every recipient, timestamp and revision recorded and exportable. Records are append-only.

Selective disclosure support

Simultaneous delivery across all lanes to avoid selective-disclosure problems.

Integration

Fits the systems your IR team already uses

Workflow Approval routing that mirrors your internal chain, with read receipts so the compliance officer can see exactly who signed off and when.
Data Structured financial data blocks in releases, plus API and webhook delivery into your IR site, CRM and reporting stack.

Get started

Give your next disclosure an audit trail.

IR engagements are scoped with your counsel and compliance team. Expect a short technical call before anything is signed.

Request an IR consultation See enterprise controls

No subscription required · Cancel anytime · Human editorial review on every release
